🚑 Quality checks and remaining work

  1. Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
    556 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.
  2. Recover source data before guessing from images
    5 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.
  3. Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
    Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.
  4. Use gold labels as training data
    Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.

retailer_description"One step. Three acids. Results that build. Andalou's Resurfacing Triple Acid Exfoliating Toner is a milky, leave-on 5% AHA toner that addresses texture, pore appearance, and the look of dark spots all at once — because your skin deserves more than a single-acid solution. Powered by Fruit Science™, glycolic, lactic, and mandelic acids each do a different job: glycolic exfoliates at the surface, lactic smooths and supports hydration, mandelic gently addresses uneven tone. Niacinamide visibly refines pore appearance while pineapple and papaya enzymes lift dull surface buildup. The result is skin that looks smoother, more even-toned, and visibly refreshed — no rinsing required. Rooted in renewal and refined by science — at Andalou, our patented Fruit Science™ innovation is clinically proven to support skin's natural wisdom. We don't fight change. We formulate for it. Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologist tested. Begin 1–2 uses weekly, increasing to daily as tolerated. Sunburn Alert: This product contains alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product and for one week after. AHAs may increase skin's sensitivity to sun exposure. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other harmful additives. Cruelty free."

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Meet the lightweight, nourishing face SPF you’ve been waiting for; one that glides on smoothly and absorbs beautifully. Never heavy. Never dry. Never greasy. Varying climates affect skin differently, so your sunscreen should adapt with the seasons; staying comfortable in heat and humidity, without leaving skin tight and dry in the cold. Our Hydrating Milk Mineral Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is designed for year-round protection. Using a reverse emulsion technology, some of the water is replaced with plant-based emollients, and liquid zinc oxide is seamlessly blended in to create a dewy, nourishing, fluid texture. EWG Verified® to ensure the highest level of safety and transparency and crafted with 16 plant-based ingredients, including sustainably sourced passionfruit oil, our Hydrating Milk Mineral Face Sunscreen delivers broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection, for both clear and sunny or cloud-covered skies alike. Fragrance-free, dermatologist tested, and suitable for sensitive skin. With 40 minutes of water resistance, this face sunscreen is ready to follow you into bright sunshine, salt-kissed sea air, or softly overcast skies, wherever the day takes you."

retailer_description"Badger Tick Spray, the ultimate organic tick repellent for humans, combines the power of nature with the assurance of safety. This extra-strength tick spray is expertly formulated to provide 6+ hours of effective protection against ticks, making it an essential addition to your outdoor adventures. Crafted with organic essential oils, this DEET-free, vegan, and plant-based anti-tick spray is not only safe for adults but also gentle enough for kids. retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Add some wholesome vegetables into your child's diet with Annie's Organic Cheesy Cheddar Baked Crackers with hidden veggies. retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Organic snacks you can bring on-the-go? Say hello to Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Granola Bars. Carefully crafted with non-GMO ingredients, these snack bars are made with no high-fructose corn syrup, so you can feel good about sharing them with the whole family. Best of all, Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Bars feature 8g of whole grain per serving. And like all Annie's granola bars, they're made with goodness. That means no artificial flavors or synthetic colors. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. 8g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Annie's Organic Honey Graham Crackers are a yummy organic snack for snackers of all ages. Made with organic wheat flour and 10 grams of whole grains per serving*, these graham crackers are perfect with lunchtime, afternoon snacks or anytime you need a quick, tasty treat. No artificial flavors or synthetic colors - just certified organic honey flavored crunches of yum. Try 'em plain, topped with nut butter, or in your favorite baking and s'more recipes. Add some joy and hoppiness to your day with Annie's - snacks made with goodness. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *10g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Bachan’s Miso Japanese Barbecue Sauce delivers a bold, savory-sweet blend of rich umami flavor made with non-GMO soy sauce, cane sugar, and a balanced combination of red and white miso, creating deep, layered savoriness. Crafted with organic rice vinegar, mirin, tomato paste, organic ginger, green onion, organic garlic, and organic toasted sesame oil, this sauce brings complexity and depth that stand up beautifully to heat. Designed for cooking, it’s ideal for marinating and grilling chicken, glazing cod or salmon before roasting, stir-frying vegetables or proteins, or stirring into broth or ramen for an extra hit of umami. Made with clean ingredients and cold-filled to preserve natural taste, it contains no added water, preservatives, or artificial additives. Inspired by a cherished family recipe developed by Justin and his dad, Bachan’s brings the bold flavors of Japanese cuisine to your table—creating meals meant to bring people together."

Made with 97% naturally derived ingredients, it features squalane to soften and smooth while helping support the skin’s natural barrier, plus chamomile extract to calm and comfort dry skin. Think of it as your milky cleanser that doubles as self-care in a bottle. And here’s the proof: it boosts hydration by +24% after a single use*, with 100% of users noticing improvement*. Immediate comfort, no dryness, just clean, happy skin. This face cleansing milk works into a light lather to wash away dirt, oil, and even mascara, leaving skin clean and hydrated. Gentle enough for daily use, even for delicate skin types. EWG VERIFIED, vegan, and dermatologically tested, this milk cleanser for face is perfect for anyone who wants a minimalist routine with maximum comfort. Add this cleansing milk to your lineup and keep your skincare milky, clean, and happy. *Hydration test conducted on 11 volunteers, measurement taken after 1 hour."

retailer_description"GT's SYNERGY Mystic Mango Kombucha is crafted by nature for the living body. Smooth, creamy, and sparkling, this raw kombucha is made with refreshing fruity, slightly sweet and tangy mango. Traditionally fermented in small batches for weeks—not days—using heirloom Himalayan cultures, it delivers billions of living probiotics to support gut health, immunity, brain function, and protein absorption. Since 1995, GT's Living Foods has been crafting functional recipes inspired by nature's healing properties. The family-owned and operated company has created a diverse portfolio of delicious and efficacious living foods for the living body. Each is made with the same unwavering commitment to real fermentation, real function, and real benefits as SYNERGY."
